CORRECTED 2026-08-13: this note previously read 'Accepting them is a concrete, checkable access claim that none of the four captured competitors surfaces.' Both halves were wrong. It asserted acceptance, the exact claim OVERCLAIM.global logs as UNCONFIRMED; and Absolute Dental, one of the four captured competitors, names Teachers Health Trust, Health Plan of Nevada and Medicaid in its own 'We Accept Most Dental Insurance' list on two captured pages. The uncontested set, absent from all 21 competitor captures, is Culinary Health Fund, Teamsters, UFCW, Sierra Health & Life and Southpoint.

rules: Never single out one named rival on the homepage.
The wedge is against the market's MODEL (single-office practices that refer out; deferred care), never against a named practice.
State only competitor facts verified first-party this run with a URL + fetch date; anything unverified is ⚠FLAG, never asserted.
Never state or imply a competitor's price without a dated first-party capture.

Do not claim a price advantage — the P1 probe shows the market's new-patient offer runs $0 (BDG) to $279 (Stunning Smiles), with Radiant Smiles' $45 undercut by the two largest multi-location groups. Price is not an available wedge.
